Filtered Water, Organic Agave, Organic Coconut Water, Organic Raspberry Concentrate, Organic Lemon Juice, Organic Dragon Fruit Flavor, Organic Fruit Punch Flavor, Sea Salt, Natural Flavor from Non-GMO Plants, Purple Carrot, Organic Monk Fruit Flavor, Organic Amla Fruit, Organic Maqui Berries, Organic Manuka Honey, Organic Ginseng, Organic Maca. Contains: Coconut.

The world’s first certified organic, plant-based electrolyte fitness beverage. With 50% fewer calories & over 30% less sugar than traditional sports drinks, Berri Fit® is truly the healthier way to hydrate.

We believe in the power of clean and organic ingredients. Berri Fit is carefully crafted to complement your healthy lifestyle, ensuring you get the most out of your workouts and daily activities.

Why compromise your hard work and dedication to a healthy lifestyle by guzzling down sugar-filled electrolyte drinks? We believe that if you're working out, it's to be healthier, so let's prioritize your well-being from the inside out.

Berri Fit cares for the whole family, offering them steady energy throughout the day. Trust Berri Fit to keep your loved ones thriving and benefitting from superior hydration.

Proactive Hydration: Don't wait until you feel thirsty, by then you're already dehydrated. Drink 1-2 bottles a day for optimal health and peace of mind.

Perfect for working out, hot days, car rides or amusement park visits!

True-to-Nature Ingredients

No Artificial Flavors, Colors, or Preservatives

*All flavors and preservatives are sourced naturally from USDA Certified organic suppliers

  • Guava

    Origin: Organically sourced from South America

    Benefits: Plant-based source of zinc to help support immune system

  • Coconut Water

    Origin: Tapped from the center of young coconuts in the Philippines

    Benefits: Isotonic, hypoallergenic, and all-natural health benefits

  • Maca Root

    Origin: Hand-selected maca roots harvested in Peru

    Benefits: Balanced energy and supports faster muscle recovery and healing

  • Sweet Potato

    Origin: Organically sourced from the U.S.A.

    Benefits: Provides carbohydrates and fiber and is a healthier alternative to sugar

  • Ginseng Root

    Origin: Organically sourced from Canada

    Benefits: Increased energy and focus

  • Sea Salt

    Origin: Naturally sourced from the ocean

    Benefits: Helps the body absorb potassium and prevents muscle pains, spasms, and cramps

  • Amla Fruit

    Origin: Organically sourced from Asia

    Benefits: Plant-based source of Vitamin C to help support immune system

  • Maqui Superberries

    Origin: Organically sourced from Chile

    Benefits: Increases energy, supports muscle recovery, and reduces fatigue and soreness

Rapid Response Hydration

As efficacious as competition using proven WHO formula for dehydration prevention. Made with premium ingredients, such as Organic Coconuts, Organic Guava, Sea Salt and Organic Sweet Potato Juice.
